    - I've kept this house forty-five years. Old Fenella kept it before me and taught me the sea-herb craft, the craft the Magicians of the first camp taught this shore.
    - There's no magic in it. Only knowing which herb, which tide and which hour.
    - Do you know what I tell Brigid? That there's no magic in it, only knowing which herb, which tide and which hour. And then that the knowing is the magic.
